note: USACE Nashville District campground on the Barren River just below the Barren River Lake dam, near Scottsville; the sites run in a long row along the river road, their pads 4-6 m above the water on a wooded bank. Stilling-basin fishing and day-use area next door, amphitheater, playground, volleyball and a nature trail; the lake is under a mile away. --Claude
summary: Kept. Fees $16-30 confirmed (peak May-Sept $30 with 50A/water, off-season primitive $16); 48 sites, max 115 ft; showers/flush and pit toilets, dump, water; year-round; rec.gov, 14-night max. WATERFRONT: riverfront -> riverview recommended (pads 4-6 m above the ~60 m wide tailwater). Pin, phone, website current.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE RECOMMENDED: stored riverfront -> riverview. The river is the Barren River tailwater, ~60 m wide. Sites 13-36 line the river side of the campground road and the pads are ~17-35 m from the water, but USGS 3DEP profiles put every pad 4-6 m above the water surface (145.3-145.6 m): site 21 (36.894844,-86.133574) 151.6 m, drops to 147.1 at 23 m and the water at ~29 m; site 13 (36.895103,-86.132304) 151.2 m, water at ~31 m; site 27 (36.894633,-86.134576) 151.1 m, water at ~24 m; site 05 (36.895544,-86.131205) 149.9 m, a 3.3 m step down to a low bench and the water at ~30 m; sites 32/34 (36.894292,-86.135600 / 36.894181,-86.136013) ~151 m with a 4 m drop to a bench and the water at 43-50 m. A 4-6 m bank is over the 1-2 m kayak test, so these are views; the bank carries scattered trees and the river is visible from the row (Esri). rec.gov tags no site 'Proximity to Water'. The stored evidence ('within ~15-25 m of the bank') measured distance only; the old note itself said 'no sites have direct water access'. Replacement evidence text: 'rec.gov catalog sites 13-36 plotted on Esri: pads 17-50 m from the ~60 m Barren River tailwater, 4-6 m above it on a wooded bank (3DEP: site 21 151.6 m vs water 145.6 m) -> riverview'.
SITES: catalog Max Vehicle Length 115 ft at sites 05 and 12 (others 52-95 ft) - written as given; every site takes 23 ft.
FACILITIES: rec.gov lists both flush and pit toilets and showers; the text says off-season service is pit toilets, dump and water only - showers are presumably peak-season.
